prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a refined GINA parent Tasks screen proposal and its Add Task sheet, matching the attached APPROVED calendar design as the exact design-system reference, not a redesign of the brand. Two portrait phone screen designs side by side on warm ivory presentation background, near-flat straight-on, no black phone frames. Same warm cream, violet satin gradient pill buttons with clear white text, dark indigo rounded friendly but sophisticated type, delicate lavender surface outlines and subtle realistic shadows, mint selected child chip. Keep EXACT mint plush mascot with two purple leaves and mint leaf, same face and body proportions, seated beside open book in a modest upper-right hero. No new mascot or costumes. Header small approved gina logo. LEFT screen: back button, title 'Görevler', subtitle 'Küçük alışkanlıklar, büyük adımlar.' child chips 'Ece' selected and 'Can'. Compact segments 'Aktif 3', 'Duraklatılan 1'. Three generous task cards with small tasteful icons on pastel tiles: 'Dişlerini fırçala' subtitle 'Her gün · 2 yıldız'; '20 dakika kitap oku' subtitle 'Pzt · Sal · Çar · Per · Cum · 3 yıldız'; 'Odanı düzenle' subtitle 'Cmt · Paz · 2 yıldız'. Each card includes clear 'Duraklat' action at least 48dp target, not a tiny unlabeled icon. A small friendly empty-bottom hint 'Her çocuk kendi hızında ilerler.' A prominent purple '＋ Yeni görev' button. Bottom navigation 'Bugün', 'Takvim', 'Prova', 'Diğer'. RIGHT screen is the Add task form expanded full-height sheet with cream background, top title 'Yeni görev', close X; compact mint 'Ece için' chip. Label 'Görev adı', field '20 dakika kitap oku'. Label 'Simge', a single row of 5 pastel icon tiles (toothbrush, book selected, tidy-room, shoes, plant) no overwhelming icon grid. Label 'Yıldız', stepper showing 3 with large minus and plus. Label 'Hangi günler?', seven equal readable pill toggles 'Pzt Sal Çar Per Cum Cmt Paz', weekday selected violet, weekend cream. Soft lavender preview card 'Ece’nin görevlerine eklenecek' with book icon and '20 dakika kitap oku'. Footer 'Vazgeç' secondary pale lavender, 'Görevi kaydet' primary violet. All Turkish text legible, no gold/black luxury clichés, no fake glass effects, no new functionality such as streaks, task ordering, completion approval on this page. Maintain elegant spacing and usable readable control sizes. This is a design proposal, not a running app screenshot.
